newsitem.title: USA: Minnesota Mining to modify O-Cel-O labels.
newsitem.headline: Minnesota Mining to modify O-Cel-O labels.

text.p: Minnesota Mining & Manufacturing Co said Tuesday it reached an agreement with the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency to modify some O-Cel-O sponge packaging labeling.
It said the new language makes it clearer that O-Cel-O sponges resist odors and kill germs in the sponge, but do not disinfect or kill germs on surfaces.

3M said the changes will allow the company to continue uninterrupted sales of O-Cel-O sponge products. It said the new packaging will be available soon. Inventory, with the existing packaging, will continue to be sold for 90 days.
